entities.summary: The Göktürk Khaganate was the first Turkic empire, spanning from Manchuria to the Black Sea. Successive waves of Turkic migration (Seljuks, Kipchaks, Ottomans) reshaped the Middle East, Central Asia, and Anatolia.
